maria (eng-runtime): hitting a sustained throughput drop on prod-gpu-pool-2, started ~1867004310. p95 latency spiking and a bunch of worker restarts.
raj (eng-sre): saw OOMs on GPUs + allocator errors. alerting rule fired: gpu_worker_restarts > 5 in 5m :warning:
aj (eng-ml): any recent kernel-selection or quantization rollouts? I pushed kernel heuristics two days ago but flagged as experimental.
maria (eng-runtime): rolled the new kernel heuristic on pool-2 last night at 1866910000, yes. didn't expect this many restarts.
ellie (eng-platform): attaching recent logs from one restarted worker:
```
[1867004325] ERROR allocator: failed to allocate 476MB slab: out of memory
[1867004326] WARN kv_cache: eviction loop: scanned 512 entries, freed 0MB
[1867004328] INFO worker: graceful shutdown (oom)
```
raj (eng-sre): kv cache not freeing memory — looks like fragmentation. eviction scanning but reclaiming nothing. suspicious of allocator slab growth + small-batch churn.
aj (eng-ml): could kernel selection be creating incompatible memory layouts? the new kernel switches to contiguous fused kernels for long sequences, might change per-layer allocation patterns.
maria (eng-runtime): profiling dump from the faulty pod shows large number of tiny allocations around KV cache eviction path. paste of heap histogram:
```
# bytes   count  type
  12MB     1024  kv_entry_meta
  40MB      512  kv_value_small
  80MB      200  tensors/tmp_buffer
```
ellie (eng-platform): interesting — many small kv entries. we've been aggressively enabling prefix caching; combined with continuous batching, the allocator gets lots of short-lived small allocs.
raj (eng-sre): mitigation plan: 1) disable experimental kernel heuristic on pool-2 (rollback), 2) force kv-cache compaction job, 3) bump oom-kill-threshold for workers temporarily. doing step 1 now.
maria (eng-runtime): rolling back kernel heuristic on pool-2: `deploy-bot rollback pool=prod-gpu-pool-2 tag=kernel-heuristic-exp` :gear:
deploy-bot: rollback started at 1867004340, target 10 pods in pool-2, rolling 2 at a time.
raj (eng-sre): kicking kv cache compaction job: `kubectl exec -it kv-compact -- /bin/compact --max-entries=100000` — launched.
aj (eng-ml): adding a small allocator patch to coalesce tiny KV slabs (hotfix) — will build a debug image; ETA ~30m.
ellie (eng-platform): after rollback, restarts dropped from ~6/min to ~1/min and throughput recovered ~13% within 5m :eyes:
maria (eng-runtime): great. leaving kv compaction running — but still seeing occasional p95 spikes when a pod that didn't get rolled yet gets hit.
raj (eng-sre): created temporary rate-limit rule for small requests on pool-2 to reduce fragmentation while hotfix lands — `rl.set pool=prod-gpu-pool-2 route=/generate smallreq 10r/s`
aj (eng-ml): pushed allocator patch to canary pool for validation. results look promising: decreased small-allocation churn by 70% in traces.
maria (eng-runtime): plan for next 24h: 1) full rollback confirmed, 2) promote allocator coalescing patch after QA, 3) add KV cache telemetry (avg entry size, fragmentation ratio), 4) postmortem and perf regression ticket.
ellie (eng-platform): opened infra ticket INF-2892 for permanent fix and dashboard widget request.
raj (eng-sre): adding incident postmortem stub: we'll include timeline, kernel heuristic diff, heap histograms, KV compaction trace, and canary results. scheduling 1hr sync at 1867005400.
maria (eng-runtime): big takeaway: kernel changes can alter allocation shapes enough to surface fragmentation/OOM under high small-batch workloads. need eval harness that includes KV cache churn scenarios.
aj (eng-ml): agree — adding tests to perf CI: synthetic small-kv bursts + kernel variation matrix.
maria (eng-runtime): thanks all. keeping this thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
